title: EasyPay
tagline: A payment link generator for small businesses to help receive payments in USDT
description:
EasyPay allow users to receive USDT payments by generating short urls instead of using long wallet addresses that are prone to human error. 

Users can connect their wallet, and quickly create a listing which generate a shortened link and QR code. 

EasyPay also help manage inventories, making it suitable for small businesses.
how_its_made:
The project is deployed on Optimism Sepolia and built with Solidity. For the frontend, we used nextJs and WAGMI to enable smooth interaction.

Our approach involves associating created listings with business wallet address, then facilitate payments via smart contract on Optimism Sepolia blockchain.
